In Soymomo we take the protection of your information very seriously. Because of this, we are writing to let you know that we have adapted our privacy policy in adherence to the new EU’s regulation 2016/679 of April 27th (GDPR), which went into effect on May 25th, 2018. 

We are informing you that your information is stored in our database located in the US. We use it to give you the best possible experience using the SoyMomo App, to keep you in touch with your children. We will also use it to inform you of any news regarding our products. 

We store information related to your children, such as their name, surname, and if you provide it, a profile picture. These are used so that you can see their SoyMomo correctly in the App, and so that you can tell different SoyMomos apart within the App, if you have more than one. Additionally, we store their date of birth, with which we will be able to send them a fun birthday message to the SoyMomo user, aside from helping us to better understand who our users are. 

SoyMomo has an integrated GPS. We store the locations received through GPS during the last 72 hours so that you can check the location history of your child from the App. 

We also store the contact information of the contacts that have been added to the SoyMomo. This includes the name and phone number, so that you may check online and at any time who can call your child’s SoyMomo. 

Finally, we store the amount of daily steps so that you can track, from the App, an estimate of the physical activity of your child. 

All the information related to your SoyMomo and your account, such as locations, phone guide contacts in the SoyMomo, and the user’s mail, will be used by the customer support staff in case that you request support. 

We want you to know that we will not use your information to give it to any third parties nor to trade it. 

If you decide that you want us to eliminate all the information related to you, taking into account that it means that you no longer will be able to use any Soymomo products, you can send us an email request at contact@soymomo.com. 

If you would like to stop receiving informational emails from Soymomo, you can also notify us at contact@soymomo.com.

The disconnection of your SoyMomo Watch could be due to the following factors:
Check if the SIM has data. The watch might have run out of gigabytes or does not have an active mobile package or plan.
Check if the watch is turned off, either due to a drained battery or accidental shutdown.
3. The watch doesn\'t recognize the SIM:
Ensure that the watch detects the SIM correctly. If the SIM was improperly removed or inserted, the watch won\'t connect.
Make sure the watch has signal. It can lose it in certain areas or buildings. Check the signal bars.
Make sure the watch’s date and time are correct. Open Settings › Date and Time on the watch and adjust it manually.

Teach your child what to do in emergencies, whom to talk to, request a call to you, or where to wait.

By tapping the Transfer button, you will start the process of moving your subscription from your current SIM card to a new one. Here's what we will perform:

 • Activate the New SIM: We'll activate your new SoyMomo SIM card, which includes generating a new phone number for you.
 • Update Subscription: Your subscription settings will be updated to link with the new SoyMomo SIM card.
 • Switch Phone Numbers: We'll replace your old phone number with the new one on all related devices and services.

 Please Note: After transferring, make sure to update your contacts with your new phone number.
